summary: A focused explanation of the chiral-event lower bound: an explicit sphere of collision events becomes antipodal under parity and an allowed symmetry, so Borsuk–Ulam forces any two continuous readings to vanish together.
summary_zh: 聚焦解释手性事件的下界：显式碰撞球面在宇称与允许对称下变成对跖映射，因此 Borsuk–Ulam 迫使任意两个连续读数同时归零。
title: The Antipodal Sphere
